title: SignAssist
lede: AI-based property and investment management platform. Defined the product vision, strategy and roadmap, managed stakeholder relationships (investors), and established product operations and analytics

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: AI-based property and investment management platform. Defined the product vision, strategy and roadmap, managed stakeholder relationships (investors), and established product operations and analytics reviews.

sections.title: Key work
sections.body:
• Led design and launch of an AI module that transforms contracts and real estate documents into structured data and compliance warnings
  • Increased active users by 87% through improved in-product onboarding and messaging
  • Implemented regular pre/prototype testing, data analysis and analytics reviews, reducing time to value by 75%
  • Developed a pricing strategy resulting in 23% MRR growth
  • Lowered CAC/LTV ratio from 162% to 21%

sections.title: Key outcomes
sections.body:
• 87% increase in active users
  • 75% reduction in time-to-value
  • CAC/LTV ratio: 162% → 21%
  • 23% MRR growth
